subject: [AMBER] hydrogen mass repartitioning with accelerated MD

messages.author: James Kress
messages.body:
Hello,
Does anyone on the list know of any MD simulations that have been performed with hydrogen mass repartitioning and accelerated or Gaussian accelerated MD?  If yes, would they please provide a link to the publication(s)?
I cannot find any on the web.
Thanks.
Jim Kress
